itinerary.title: Cairo to Saint Catherine: southern Sinai road
itinerary.source: Check-in at the local hotel — the Monastery Guesthouse, Daniela Village, Catherine Plaza, depending on season — and an early dinner.

itinerary.title: Mount Sinai climb, monastery, return to Cairo
itinerary.source: The descent from Saint Catherine back to Cairo is the rest of the day — the same southern Sinai road in reverse, arrival in Cairo by evening.
